rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something occurring or existing to the highest degree, such as maximum effect.

example.english: This method can achieve maximum effect.
example.traditional: 呢個方法可以發揮最大效力。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 fong1 faat3 ho2 ji5 faat3 fai1 zeoi3 daai6 haau6 lik6

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for the highest permitted or possible limit.

example.english: The daily withdrawal maximum on this credit card is twenty thousand dollars.
example.traditional: 呢張信用卡每日提款上限係兩萬蚊。
example.jyutping: ni1 zoeng1 seon3 jung6 kaa1 mui5 jat6 tai4 fun2 soeng6 haan6 hai6 loeng5 maan6 man1

rows.note: Use this general mathematical term for the greatest value, especially a global maximum.

example.english: The maximum of this curve is at this point.
example.traditional: 呢條曲線嘅最大值喺呢個位。
example.jyutping: ni1 tiu4 kuk1 sin3 ge3 zeoi3 daai6 zik6 hai2 ni1 go3 wai2

rows.note: Use this specifically for a local maximum of a function rather than its greatest value overall.

example.english: Within this interval, the function has a local maximum at this point.
example.traditional: 喺呢個區間入面，函數喺呢個點有局部最大值。
example.jyutping: hai2 ni1 go3 keoi1 gaan1 jap6 min6 haam4 sou3 hai2 ni1 go3 dim2 jau5 guk6 bou6 zeoi3 daai6 zik6
